1: // Simple Starfall Defender game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10:   // Generate starfield
11:   const stars = [];
12:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
13:     stars.push({
14:       x: Math.random() * W,
15:       y: Math.random() * H,
16:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
17:     });
18:   }
19:   const planet = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, r: 40 };
20:   const ship = {
21:     radius: 20,
22:     orbit: planet.r + 30,
23:     angle: 0, // radians
24:     rotationSpeed: Math.PI / 180 * 3,
25:   };
26: 
27:   const asteroids = [];
28:   const lasers = [];
29:   let lastAsteroid = 0;
30:   let gameOver = false;
31:   const keys = {};
32: 
33:   // Audio setup
34:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
35:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
36:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
37:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
38:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
39:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
40:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
41:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
42:     oscillator.start();
43:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
44:   }
45:   function playLaser() { playTone(800, 100); }
46:   function playExplosion() { playTone(200, 300); }
47:   function playGameOver() { playTone(100, 600); }
48: 
49:   // Input handling
50:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { 
51:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
52:     keys[e.code] = true; 
53:   });
54:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
55: 
56:   function spawnAsteroid() {
57:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
58:     const distance = Math.max(W, H) * 0.6;
59:     asteroids.push({
60:       x: planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * distance,
61:       y: planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * distance,
62:       vx: (planet.x - (planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * distance)) * 0.0015,
63:       vy: (planet.y - (planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * distance)) * 0.0015,
64:       r: 10 + Math.random() * 10,
65:     });
66:   }
67: 
68:   function fireLaser() {
69:     const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.orbit;
70:     const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.orbit;
71:     const speed = 5;
72:     lasers.push({
73:       x: sx,
74:       y: sy,
75:       vx: Math.cos(ship.angle) * speed,
76:       vy: Math.sin(ship.angle) * speed,
77:     });
78:     playLaser();
79:   }
80: 
81:   function update(dt) {
82:     if (gameOver) return;
83:     // Ship rotation
84:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.rotationSpeed;
85:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.rotationSpeed;
86:     // Fire
87:     if (keys['Space']) {
88:       if (!keys._spacePressed) {
89:         fireLaser();
90:         keys._spacePressed = true;
91:       }
92:     } else {
93:       keys._spacePressed = false;
94:     }
95: 
96:     // Spawn asteroids every 1.5s
97:     const now = performance.now();
98:     if (now - lastAsteroid > 1500) {
99:       spawnAsteroid();
100:       lastAsteroid = now;
101:     }
102: 
103:     // Update asteroids
104:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
105:       const a = asteroids[i];
106:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
107:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
108:       // Collision with planet
109:       const dxp = a.x - planet.x;
110:       const dyp = a.y - planet.y;
111:       if (Math.hypot(dxp, dyp) < planet.r + a.r) {
112:         gameOver = true;
113:         playExplosion();
114:         playGameOver();
115:         alert('Game Over: Planet smashed!');
116:         return;
117:       }
118:       // Collision with ship
119:       const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.orbit;
120:       const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.orbit;
121:       const dxs = a.x - sx;
122:       const dys = a.y - sy;
123: if (Math.hypot(dxs, dys) < a.r + 8) {
124:           gameOver = true;
125:           playExplosion();
126:           playGameOver();
127:           alert('Game Over: Ship destroyed!');
128:           return;
129:         }
130:     }
131: 
132:     // Update lasers
133:     for (let i = lasers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
134:       const l = lasers[i];
135:       l.x += l.vx * dt;
136:       l.y += l.vy * dt;
137:       // Remove off‑screen
138:       if (l.x < 0 || l.x > W || l.y < 0 || l.y > H) lasers.splice(i, 1);
139:     }
140: 
141:     // Laser‑asteroid collisions
142:     for (let i = lasers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
143:       const l = lasers[i];
144:       for (let j = asteroids.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
145:         const a = asteroids[j];
146:         if (Math.hypot(l.x - a.x, l.y - a.y) < a.r) {
147:           lasers.splice(i, 1);
148:           asteroids.splice(j, 1);
149:           playExplosion();
150:           break;
151:         }
152:       }
153:     }
154:   }
155: 
156:   function draw() {
157: // Background
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
159:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
160:     // Stars
161:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
162:     stars.forEach(s => {
163:       ctx.beginPath();
164:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
165:       ctx.fill();
166:     });
167:     // Planet with radial gradient
168:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r * 0.2, planet.x, planet.y, planet.r);
169:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3ddc84');
170:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2b8a3e');
171:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
172:     ctx.beginPath();
173:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
174:     ctx.fill();
175: 
176:     // Ship (triangle)
177:     const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.orbit;
178:     const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.orbit;
179:     ctx.save();
180:     ctx.translate(sx, sy);
181:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
182:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
183:     ctx.beginPath();
184:     ctx.moveTo(0, -8);
185:     ctx.lineTo(6, 8);
186:     ctx.lineTo(-6, 8);
187:     ctx.closePath();
188:     ctx.fill();
189:     ctx.restore();
190: 
191:     // Asteroids with gradient
192:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
193:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
194:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
195:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
196:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
197:       ctx.beginPath();
198:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
199:       ctx.fill();
200:     });
201: 
202:     // Lasers
203:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff0';
204:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
205:     lasers.forEach(l => {
206:       ctx.beginPath();
207:       ctx.moveTo(l.x, l.y);
208:       ctx.lineTo(l.x - l.vx * 2, l.y - l.vy * 2);
209:       ctx.stroke();
210:     });
211:   }
212: 
213:   let last = performance.now();
214:   function loop() {
215:     const now = performance.now();
216:     const dt = now - last;
217:     last = now;
218:     update(dt);
219:     draw();
220:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
221:   }
222: 
223:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
224: })();
